text:
maya: heads-up — planning to launch the new OSS reference app (edge-inference-refkit) next tues. need: blog post, a 10-min tutorial, benchmark narrative (latency/cost), a short demo webinar + inbound lead routing setup. anyone available to own exec brief and launch post?

liam: I can take the launch post + webinar landing page. can we lock the date? tues works but prefer afternoon PT.

ana: I can write the tutorial (step-by-step repo tour + quickstart). will need a couple of screenshots and 1 small gif. ETA EOD fri for draft.

sanjay: quick note on benchmarks — we should surface: median p50/p95 latencies, token/sec, and $$$/1k tokens at default batching. Also include local reproducibility steps and the config (GPU type, quantization).

sanjay: example command to run the micro-bench locally:
```bash
python bench.py --model rdx-7b-quant --seq 512 --batch 4 --gpu gtx-a100 --iters 300
```

maya: perfect. liam — for the benchmark narrative, aim for a short explainer: what the numbers mean for a small product team (latency vs cost tradeoff) + a one-line recommendation. keep it non-academic.

liam: noted. for inbound routing: propose gated webinar sign-up (email + company) -> send to marketing CRM and tag as "edge-refkit-interest". can we have a short form that pre-fills org size?

ana: form fields: name, email, company, company_size (dropdown), use_case (free text). also ask if they want a dedicated trial for dedicated/dedicated private.

maya: devrel-bot — can you create a calendar placeholder for Tues 3pm PT and a checklist in the launch board? :calendar:

devrel-bot: created event "Edge Inference Refkit — Launch Demo" for 2026-04-07 15:00 PT. checklist created: blog draft -> tutorial -> benchmarks -> landing page -> webinar RSVP -> press/social kit.

liam: social kit items: 2 tweets, one LinkedIn post, 1 short demo clip (30s), and 1 short dev quote. who can capture the 30s clip during the dry run?

sanjay: I can record a 30s clip showing `./run_demo.sh` on CPU fallback + one line about perf. will keep it raw for authenticity.

ana: copy request: liam, can you drop headline + 3 bullets by tomorrow morning? I’ll slot copy into tutorial.

liam: will do. headline draft: "Ship edge-friendly LLM features with the new Edge Inference Refkit". bullets: 1) quick start in 10 mins, 2) reproducible perf that scales, 3) production-ready defaults + guides.

maya: final quick checklist for owners:
- liam: launch post + landing page + form mapping to CRM
- ana: tutorial + screenshots + GIF
- sanjay: benchmark numbers + 30s clip + repo readiness
- maya: webinar host + press/social calendar

maya: anything missing? if not, we’ll run a dry-run demo on fri 11am PT.

liam: sounds good. adding tasks to the launch board now. :rocket:

ana: ack — will upload draft tutorial to the doc by fri 09:00 PT.

sanjay: will post benchmark logs and script in the repo under /benchmarks by thurs EOD.

maya: sweet — thanks all. we’ll reconvene on the dry-run thread if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
